verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax docs confirm automated VAT/GST calculation based on customer/business location and tax codes, and a community report confirms VAT-number (VIES) validation exists, but that same first-hand account states validation only fires once and is never re-triggered — contradicting a true 'real-time' registry check — and no evidence anywhere documents explicit reverse-charge logic for B2B cross-border sales. Missing for 10: explicit reverse-charge documentation, continuous/real-time VIES re-validation, and independent confirmation of correct B2B cross-border handling beyond the disputed one-time check.
